presets.name: Deep Space
presets.summary: Near black, stars in cold white.
presets.description: Darker and colder than the style's own skies, which pushes the constellation forward and drops everything else away.

presets.name: Warm Night
presets.summary: A brown-violet sky and amber stars.
presets.description: The other end of the same idea: a sky closer to city light than to deep space, with stars that read as amber rather than white.

presets.name: Blueprint
presets.summary: Pale lines on a flat blue.
presets.description: Trades the night for plan paper. The sky becomes one flat blue and the stars a single pale ink, which reads as a diagram of a constellation rather than a photograph of one.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.summary: A grey sky and white stars.
presets.description: Strips the color from a style that is mostly one color anyway. What is left is the geometry: points and the lines between them.

presets.name: Daylight
presets.summary: A pale sky with dark stars.
presets.description: The one preset that abandons the night. Inverting sky and stars turns the constellation into a mark on paper, which suits a light interface where a black square would punch a hole.

presets.name: Electric
presets.description: Colors past anything the style ships, on the darkest sky, so the constellation reads as lit rather than lit up.

presets.name: Animated
presets.summary: Turns the style's built-in animation on.
presets.description: The style ships an animation component that is off by default. The `animation` tag switches it on and lets the seed pick a speed. It respects prefers-reduced-motion.
